 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Vinay Kumar Mishra  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Rajiv Nayan  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 4 13-09-2024 Heard learned counsels for the parties.

2. Earlier petitioner moved his Court vide Cr. Misc. No.55085 of 2023, which was rejected on 21.12.2023 by this Court and this is the second attempt of the petitioner for grant of anticipatory bail on the ground that petitioner has solemnized marriage with the O.P. No.2.
3. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Warisnagar P.S. Case No.55 of 2021,
registered for the offences u/s 341, 321, 354(B), 376, 324 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 2, 4 & 8 of the POCSO Act.
4.
In compliance of the order dated 02.08.2024, the petitioner and informant/O.P. No.2 are present in the Court.
The Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.43275 of 2024(4) dt.13-09-2024 informant/O.P No.2 submitted in the Court that she and petitioner have solemnized marriage with her consent.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering the statement of the O.P. No.2, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his/her arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/Successor Court in connection with Warisnagar P.S. Case No.55 of 2021, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) shikha/-
